load_pretssel_vocoder_config: load the PretsselVocoder configuration using the ConfigLoader with asset_store and vocoder_archs
load_pretssel_vocoder_model: load a PretsselVocoder model from fairseq2 assets using the ModelLoader with config loader and builder
create_vocoder_model: create a PretsselVocoder model instance from a VocoderConfig using the builder function
use_vocoder_archs: access the vocoder_archs registry to define or look up PretsselVocoder architecture specifications
use_vocoder_config: instantiate a VocoderConfig object to configure PretsselVocoder model parameters
